requirements.title: Distinct branded home, app grid and assistant entry; independent package and storage identity
requirements.gate: E: LauncherApps (LauncherLibrary's replacement on upstream SystemLauncherApps since bc71e21f3b), which has never run, and the HOME-role phase (SettingsRoles, LauncherHome) on a distributable launcher APK; then D on the selected phone
requirements.remaining: The All-apps drawer, search and landscape Home exist; the drawer launches the exact component (package, activity and user) through upstream SystemLauncherApps (elizaOS/eliza#35909), which replaced LauncherLibrary.java at the pin bc71e21f3b. LauncherHome and SettingsRoles passed in the runner's --home-role phase on the launcher flavor, class E on developer APKs with an unpackaged resident runtime (not distributable), one API 36 arm64 SDK emulator, at 2961bd9e and 9a1ca161 (pin 13c9857598); that is not B (distributable), I or D evidence. LauncherLibraryInstrumentedTest, now LauncherAppsInstrumentedTest on SystemLauncherApps, has no recorded run (MVP-53). RotationInstrumentedTest passed at 73b973a5 (pin 352d7a08) and 6dcdde34 (pin 40dbe96bd1) and was not run at 13c9857598. At 200% text the Home scroller now ends above the composer (test/browser/home-compact-scroll.spec.ts, browser build); the Accessibility class that failed on that step in round 8 has not been rerun. Package and storage identity are checked by test/product-identity.test.mjs. The All-apps drawer, search and landscape Home exist with browser tests against a stubbed bridge. On an emulator the HOME-role phase passed on developer APKs at the current pin (round 8: SettingsRoles and LauncherHome 3 of 3 on the final APKs with the original HOME holder read back; class E), and the launcher flavor keeps one live MainActivity when the role is granted. LauncherLibraryInstrumentedTest has never run (MVP-53). No distributable build, image or phone has run any of it.

requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build at the current pin and scripts/verify-apks.mjs marks the releases distributable:true, which needs the release signer (A-06); then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: No distribution APK build exists at the current pin (bc71e21f3b) or the previous one (13c9857598). The pin move to bc71e21f3b changed the llama.cpp engine gitlink (CVE-2026-107183 fix), so the reviewed ARM64 embedding host no longer matches its source: android/embedding-host/qualified-host.json is marked for requalification and distribution builds refuse it until a new receipt is reviewed and staged (a candidate was built, class B, not staged). Developer APKs without the resident runtime were built there (hosted Android foundation runs 38118499272 at c0b19147 and 38131665152 at f87850fa, and development machines) and installed on one API 36 arm64 emulator at 2961bd9e and 9a1ca161, where LauncherHome and SettingsRoles (--home-role), LocalAgentOfflineApps, Shell and NoMockProduct passed: class E on developer APKs only. There is no distribution B build and no class I or D evidence. scripts/verify-apks.mjs passes a developer APK as a developer build; it marks a release distributable only when it is signed by the certificate in android/release-signer.json, which stays unset until A-06, and carries the packaged resident runtime and qualified speech. A distribution build also needs the reviewed embedding host. The MVP completion integration compiled both flavors' app and instrumentation Java (compile only, no APK) and added RendererRecoveryInstrumentedTest, which has not run. Both flavors of a developer build were installed on an emulator in round 8 and the default classes passed except BrowserFlow, which fails on its live-search method (class E). The Welcome dialog's local-apps entry is covered by a stubbed-bridge browser test; nothing has run on a device.

requirements.title: Owner-bound managed service sign-in and subscription for a local-only agent
requirements.gate: S: local-only service onboarding and subscription policy, then R/D authentication and latency
requirements.remaining: Production Android pairing is retired by design: a flag-off build admits only https://api.eliza.app and opens only eliza.app, cloud.eliza.app and accounts.google.com externally (ConnectionRoutes.java). A sign-in as a second Cloud account revokes the first account's key once before the new key is stored, unless Cloud returns the same key; the resident conversation history stays with the local owner, not the Cloud account (test/browser/cloud-account-replacement.production.spec.ts). Route and origin guards, self-revocation and account replacement have synthetic, host JVM and stubbed-bridge coverage only. ConnectionRoutesInstrumentedTest is compiled and has not run; no live Eliza Cloud revocation and no device run exist. MVP-04/MVP-34: remove hosted-agent product paths, migrate credit UI to subscriptions, qualify owner-bound inference without a per-turn billing preflight.

requirements.title: Resident agent execution and powered-on scheduling with disclosed hosted text inference
requirements.gate: E then D: resident lifecycle, history, missed occurrences and no duplicate effects
requirements.remaining: MVP-21/MVP-38: qualify resident-only execution and cancellation; remove hosted-agent fallback and retain historical data without reconnecting it. Resident failures are reported by kind in stream and JSON replies, a lost network shows a notice beside the composer and sends nothing, and a start failure leaves the resident recovering with a Retry; there is no local-apps-only mode (P-43) (flag-off specs with a stubbed bridge, class S). A flag-off build still admits a direct Cerebras key through configureProvider, which the resident instrumentation relies on (A-20); the Cloud branch is limited to cerebras and qwen-3.8-27b (LocalAgentProviderAdmissionTest, host JVM).

requirements.title: Always-local native STT/TTS, dictation, interruptible voice assistant and AOSP listening
requirements.gate: S: native speech/turn integration, then E both ABIs and D audio/latency/listening
requirements.remaining: MVP-01/MVP-23/MVP-24/MVP-52: candidate benchmarks and AOSP always-on acceptance are open. Distinct Transcribe (editable draft) and voice assistant (auto-submit) controls, VAD endpointing (Clef is not in pin c7a9a0d7e7, so the documented long-gap fallback decides), cancellation with stop reconciliation, barge-in with heard-content accounting and owner-bound teardown exist with class S evidence only (#423); echo, barge-in timing, lock and calls need device acceptance, and the agent's own memory still holds an interrupted reply in full (upstream gap). The send policy is one constant that keeps today's sending of ongoing Cloud turns until MVP-01 is decided; local-first speech with Cloud only by disclosed opt-in is the PRD wording, pending MVP-01. A Cloud reply with no speech says so, and voice timing marks, including the live ASR latency numbers, are in the diagnostics export. On-device speech: the retired Sherpa engine failed functional acceptance on a physical arm64-v8a device (D); decision P-42 replaces it with libelizainference, and at pin c7a9a0d7e7 the device route uses the shared paradee-voice library with Paradee-8M TTS (P-54) and Phonon-2 in the ASR slot (P-55, backend parakeet, CC-BY-4.0 attribution and NOTICE shipped, training-data terms flagged). The Android voice assistant and Transcribe stream app-process Silero VAD frames to the resident agent's live ASR route and the assistant applies the unchanged send policy to each finished turn; interim partials do not reach the phone because Alpha does not yet consume the private agent-event IPC subscriptions available at fb6232523074 (consumer wiring gap). Live voice has class S evidence only (node and Playwright with a stub agent, Gradle compilation). The engine libraries and bundle are recorded in android/voice-host/qualified-voice-host.json (not qualified) and staged by scripts/android-stage-voice-models.mjs; only class B and host evidence exists, no emulator or device run (docs/fused-speech.md); whether on-device speech is still required is A-24. The voice, voice-revoke and voice-limit campaigns passed on both flavors at 6dcdde34 (round 7, pin 40dbe96bd1) and were not rerun at 13c9857598. Always-on listening and hardware invocation (MVP-52) are open and owner-gated.

Use in email and the availability review inside the WebView have no emulator test: both need an agent session that a bundled APK cannot script (MVP-12, MVP-14). R (OAuth 401) and D stay open. On an emulator at the current pin the Calendar campaign passed on both flavors of the developer APKs (round 8, class E, fixture rows in the emulator's CalendarProvider): CalendarCrud, both CalendarAgentCrud methods, CalendarAvailability, CalendarTruncation, CalendarRange and CalendarFlow; InboxOperationJournal, MailAttachment and the inbox restart campaign passed there too.
